changelog: Timezone: tradeLimitStatus() and CalculatorController's three 'what day is it' call sites (autoRiskPreview(), getRiskStatus(), sizePreview()'s trade_date fallback) all used bare date('Y-m-d') -- the server's own default PHP timezone, which this app never sets explicitly (no date_default_timezone_set() anywhere), not necessarily the trader's real day boundary (Africa/Kigali, UTC+2, no DST). ReportCardController already solved exactly this for itself with a fixed Africa/Kigali constant (v3.18.0) but nothing else in the app reused it.

Added helpers.php::appTodayKigali() -- the same DateTime/timezone construction ReportCardController::today() already used, extracted so every 'today' computation shares one implementation instead of drifting independently. ReportCardController::today() now delegates to it; verified by hand that this is a pure refactor (identical output, same timezone name, same format) -- ReportCardController's own behavior is unchanged. tradeLimitStatus() and all three CalculatorController call sites now use the shared helper.

Verified the fix has real effect, not just a refactor: simulated 2026-09-27 23:30 UTC (= 2026-09-28 01:30 in Kigali, already past midnight there) -- a bare date('Y-m-d') under a UTC server default would say '2026-09-27' while the trader's own calendar day is already '2026-09-28'. This is exactly the boundary case flagged in the original diagnostic (a trade closed just after midnight Kigali time landing on the wrong side of 'today' for the risk ladder's start-of-day balance and the trade-limit counts).
release_notes: No schema changes in this release -- nothing to migrate. Per instruction, nothing was deployed as part of this turn.
